gate: Hash frozen before the holdout. Official engine 1.32.7, paired against the unmodified public base on identical opponents/seeds/seats, both seats. Gate: total paired score >= +6, score against the base (mirror) >= 70%, no opponent with a paired delta below -2.0 (one world, both seats), no reported errors/fallbacks, every callback < 1000 ms. The panel includes the ten strongest agents of the final public wave, the most copied older ones (V54 guard, One More Wheat, Pipe-16) and our own two live Frontier10 agents, so that a candidate that loses on the climb from 600 would show it. The Kaggle kernel then repeats the paired comparison on four fresh seeds (total > 0, no opponent below the control). Registered before the run.
